title: God's Strength in Weakness
definition: God's strength in weakness means that His grace and power are displayed through human limitation, suffering, and dependence.
summary: Weakness does not disqualify believers from God's love or usefulness. It often becomes the place where His grace is most clearly seen.
christFocus: Christ's power rests on His people in weakness and teaches them to depend on Him.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Weakness does not disqualify believers from God's love or usefulness. It often becomes the place where His grace is most clearly seen.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
